mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE created_time >= #{ms}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM biz_order WHERE created_time >= #{ms} AND status IN ('PAID','INSTALLING','DONE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE status IN ('PENDING','ASSIGNED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sla_record WHERE created_time >= #{ms}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sla_record WHERE created_time >= #{ms} AND sla_status = 'MET'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compensation WHERE created_time >= #{ms}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(comp_amount),0) FROM compensation WHERE created_time >= #{ms}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE created_time >= #{from} AND created_time < #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mobile_total),0) FROM traffic_usage WHERE period_month = #{month}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM traffic_usage WHERE period_month = #{month} AND mobile_used >= mobile_total
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM traffic_usage WHERE period_month = #{month} AND (mobile_total - mobile_used) <= 5
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, FROM_UNIXTIME(accept_time/1000), FROM_UNIXTIME(complete_time/1000))), 0) FROM sla_record WHERE complete_time IS NOT NULL AND complete_time > 0

SELECT o.id, o.customer_name AS customer, pkg.name AS pkgName, o.community_name AS community, o.sales_name AS sales, o.amount, o.status, o.created_time AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(o.created_time/1000), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN package_info pkg ON pkg.id = o.package_id ORDER BY o.created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.name AS customer, p.name AS pkg, t.mobile_used AS used, t.mobile_total AS total FROM traffic_usage t JOIN customer c ON c.id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN package_info p ON p.id = c.package_id WHERE t.period_month = #{month} ORDER BY (t.mobile_used / GREATEST(t.mobile_total, 1)) DESC LIMIT 6
